scenarios.title: rapid text selection applies formatting and anchors a comment to exactly that text
scenarios.interaction: fresh isolated browser context; default blank document, native pointer and ASCII keyboard; no model fixture, fault injection or synthetic IME/clipboard
scenarios.expected: exact selected text bold/font-weight700; exact comment anchor and body persist after save-status and same-ID reload
reproduce: Open the isolated Word application in a fresh browser context.
Use pointer and ASCII keyboard to select text, apply bold and anchor a comment.
Wait for saved status, reload the same document URL and inspect retained content.
Open the comments pane and inspect the exact anchor/body.

scenarios.title: layout actions open real settings and table insertion accepts dimensions
scenarios.interaction: fresh isolated browser context; native file/new action and pointer/ASCII keyboard; no model fixture, fault injection or synthetic IME/clipboard

reproduce: Open the isolated Word application in a fresh browser context.
Use pointer and ASCII keyboard to accept the new-document confirmation, author a paragraph, insert a 4-column 2-row table and edit its first two cells.
Wait for saved status, reload the same document URL and inspect retained content.
Download DOCX through the file menu and inspect actual document.xml paragraph/table/cell content.

scenarios.title: sample deck keeps immediate toolbar-new-slide typing on the new slide through undo, redo and reload
scenarios.interaction: native pointer menu + browser ASCII keyboard; sample starter model, blank deck created via visible file action; read-only model and DOM diagnostics
scenarios.expected: new active slide holds STABLECASE once; all previous complete slides unchanged; undo/redo and persisted reload preserve ordered content and formatting; actual downloaded deck equals the complete persisted document including resources and has the marker exactly once
reproduce: Open the isolated Slides application with a fresh context and sample deck.
For blank cases create a blank deck through the file menu.
Add a slide through the toolbar menu; type ASCII immediately or after the specified nine seconds.
Assert active slide and unchanged previous slides; undo, redo, save and reload the same URL.
Download the deck and compare the complete persisted document, including resources, with the actual JSON.

scenarios.title: flushes the last Word keystroke before navigation, and blocks navigation on storage failure
scenarios.interaction: Native last Word input; synthetic IndexedDB put failure preserves pending input and blocks navigation
scenarios.expected: Final native input survives navigation into another product and reopening the exact original URL; injected storage failure blocks navigation and preserves pending Word input where selected
reproduce: Create/open the selected product in the workspace; use its real editor to type the final marker.
Navigate immediately to the library without waiting for autosave and enter another product.
Reopen the original item; assert exact identity and final authored content.
For existing Word fault case inject IndexedDB put failure and assert navigation remains blocked with pending text; existing Note case holds timers to isolate flush.
